test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average age of 10 men is increased by 3 years, when three of them whose ages are 15 years, 16 years and 17 years are replaced by three new men. Find the average age of the three new men.
solution:
Formula:

Average age = Total age of men ÷ Total number of men

Calculation:

Let the average age be "a".

Total age of men = 10 × a = 10a

Total age of men to be replaced = 15 + 16 + 17 = 48 years

Let the total age of new three men = "M"

According to the question-

⇒ 10a-48 +Mover10 = a + 3

⇒ 10a - 48 + M = 10a + 30

⇒ M = 78 years

∴ Average age of three new men = 78over3 = 26 years

The average of three new men is 26 years.
